T: A thousand dollars buys a girlfriend. Not dinner.
D: A nerdy teenager pays the most popular girl at school to pretend to date him for a month.
P: Serve the snacks when Ronald and Cindy walk into the cafeteria together.
S: the cafeteria where everyone watches them walk in

Chicken tenderloins crumbed in panko and parmesan, baked crisp, served on a tray with honey mustard dipping sauce and crunchy potato gems. Toss 600g chicken tenderloins in 50g flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then press into 100g panko mixed with 30g grated parmesan and paprika. Lay on a lined tray with 500g frozen potato gems, spray with oil and bake at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon, 3 tbsp honey and 3 tbsp mayonnaise for the dip. Serve on a tray.
Mini franks wrapped in bacon and griddled until crisp, tucked into soft rolls with warm pinto beans, diced tomato, onion, mustard and a spoon of jalapeño salsa.
Baked potato halves scooped out, filled with bacon and cheddar, baked crisp and topped with sour cream and chives.
M: Beef chuck braised with dried chillies, garlic and cumin until it shreds, rolled with cheddar in flour tortillas, fried crisp, with sour cream and guacamole. Soak 3 dried chillies, blitz with 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and 400ml beef stock. Braise 1kg beef chuck in the sauce, covered, at 160C for 3 hours, then shred and reduce until thick. Lay the beef and 150g grated cheddar on 8 large flour tortillas, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Fry seam side down at 180C for 2 minutes a side until crisp. Serve with sour cream and guacamole.
Corn tortillas rolled around chicken and cheddar, baked in red chilli sauce under more melted cheese.
W: their first public date in town
Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with hot fudge of dark chocolate melted into cream, whipped cream piped high, chopped peanuts and a cherry on top.
K: the borrowed white suede outfit and the red wine stain
Cranberry juice and lemonade with sliced orange over ice in a big jug, red enough to make anyone nervous.

s.how: Wrap 16 cocktail franks in half rashers of bacon, 8 rashers in total, and griddle until crisp. Tuck into 16 mini rolls with warm pinto beans, diced tomato and onion, mustard and jalapeño salsa.

Bake 6 medium potatoes at 200C for 50 minutes. Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins with 30g melted butter. Fill with 150g fried diced bacon and 150g grated cheddar, bake 10 minutes more, then top with sour cream and chives.

m.how: Simmer 400g shredded cooked chicken in 500ml red enchilada sauce for 5 minutes. Fill 8 warmed corn tortillas with the chicken and 150g grated cheddar, roll and lay in a baking dish. Pour over 250ml more sauce, top with 100g cheddar and bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Scatter with coriander.

w.note: their first public date in town
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate into 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and pipe whipped cream high. Top with chopped peanuts and a cherry.

d.note: the borrowed white suede outfit and the red wine stain
d.how: Pour 500ml cranberry juice and 750ml lemonade into a big jug with ice and sliced orange. Stir gently and pour carefully into glasses, nowhere near anyone's borrowed white suede outfit.
